name: Tassels
editorial_article:
"Tassels" is a poignant 2024 single by the Calgary-based singer-songwriter Elle McAndrews, serving as a nostalgic meditation on the innocence of youth. Released on April 18, 2024, the track is deeply rooted in the artist’s "La bElle Epoch" creative phase, a period characterized by a seamless blend of pop, soul, and alternative sensibilities. Lyrically, the song functions as a tribute to the carefree days of childhood—specifically capturing the image of friends racing bikes through town with ribbons fluttering in the wind, a metaphor for an unburdened sense of freedom that feels increasingly distant as time passes. 

Musically, "Tassels" balances a rhythmic, driving energy with a melancholic, reflective vocal performance. The arrangement, produced by Laura Smith, features understated but evocative contributions from guitarist Andrew Braun and drummer Flavio Cirillo. The song’s central hook—the visual of "tassels on your bike" dancing in the light—anchors the listener in a tangible, sepia-toned memory. By juxtaposing the warmth of past companionship with the cold emptiness of the present, McAndrews delivers a universal exploration of how memory can simultaneously provide comfort and highlight the melancholy of inevitable transition. It stands as a refined example of modern indie-pop that favors emotional resonance over sheer spectacle, situating Elle McAndrews as a distinct voice within the vibrant Canadian independent music scene.
